observations: Two Porsche 911 993 engines are shown in a workshop setting.
The engine on the left has a silver valve cover with 'PORSCHE' embossed on it.
The engine on the right has a black valve cover with 'PORSCHE' and '993' embossed on it.
Both engines have a black air intake manifold with red handwritten markings.
The engines appear to be used, with visible dirt and grime on the valve covers and surrounding components.
A watermark 'EZP PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is visible across the images.
